about: The gate for remediation-v2. Its components and thresholds are exactly those of t1/rl/remediation/targets.json version 3 (v1's gate, sha256 8757591f2eb44ac8f7805e1fcd5b150db8c41d63393651aba83ed668ac8f1be0): the joint target on the 1,008 frozen held-out incidents, now with v2 as the candidate against ppo_sm_50k. Declared before v2 is trained or evaluated. Graded by t3/evals/graders.py (network level) and t3/evals/percell.py percell-v1 (per cell), both by twin replay against the same-step healthy counterfactual; no model grades another.

candidate.what: remediation-v2 (t1/rl/remediation/v2.py): v1's behaviour cloning with better inputs (KPI changes against the pre-incident baseline, no configuration history) and residual DAgger over the three operator steps

operators.v1: remediation-v1 (reported: v2 - v1 on every component)
operators.ppo_sm_50k: the deployed policy: the baseline of every pass/fail component
operators.config_revert: not re-run: cited from v1's gate run t3.evals.remediation-policy-20261104T085949Z
operators.rule_baseline: not re-run: cited from v1's gate run t3.evals.remediation-policy-20261104T085949Z

primary.what: the 1,008 masked incidents of the frozen held-out set t1/rl/remediation/suite/heldout-v2.jsonl (56 strata x 18: 7 templates x 4 base cells x 2 presets, seeds from the reserved block 2,000,001-2,022,400, frozen on x86_64 with a full self-replay check); v2 and ppo_sm_50k graded identically
primary.rule: PASS only if all three components pass. Each component is a paired-bootstrap lower bound that must be above its own threshold; the unit's value is the smallest margin (ci_low minus threshold), so value > 0 if and only if all three pass. tools/check_unit.py part e replays every component (JOINT_METRIC).

components.name: percell_recovered
components.what: item score = percell_recovered(v2) - percell_recovered(ppo_sm_50k), each 1 or 0: t3/evals/percell.py percell-v1, every cell green against its own healthy state at the grade step

components.name: network_recovery_noninferior
components.what: recovery(v2) - recovery(ppo_sm_50k), network level (t3/evals/graders.py, capped at 1.0): v2 may be at most 0.05 worse (non-inferiority)

primary.item_score: percell_recovered(v2) - percell_recovered(ppo_sm_50k); extra.diff holds all three component differences against ppo_sm_50k, extra.diff_vs_v1 the same three against v1 (reported only)
primary.interval: paired-bootstrap-v1 over item ids, subset extra.suite = heldout, t3/evals/targets.json bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 20261102, 95%)
primary.replication: the same three components on confirm, test-visible and dev-holdout; reported, not part of pass/fail
primary.continuity: the same three components on the 18 test-masked incidents (the judged swarm's set), reported for continuity with earlier results; not part of pass/fail

heldout_use.rule: v2 was developed on dev data only (t1/rl/remediation/candidates-v2.jsonl train and val roles; the deadzone chosen on the val incidents); its training and tuning processes ran with t1/rl/remediation/guard.py installed, which refuses every open() of t1/rl/remediation/suite/heldout-*. What was learnt from v1's gate result was its summary (per-cell 19%, network 60%, diagnosis 84%, the learning curve's decision: better inputs), not any incident of the set.

comparisons_reported.v2_minus_v1: the same three components, v2 against v1, on every set (reported, not pass/fail)

suites.heldout: frozen remediation held-out set t1/rl/remediation/suite/heldout-v2.jsonl (1,008 masked; the primary set). heldout-v1.jsonl stays committed as history and is not evaluated.
suites.confirm: frozen confirmation suite t3/evals/suite/incidents-confirm.jsonl (18 masked, fresh seeds 990003-990271)
suites.dev-holdout: role=holdout candidates of t1/rl/remediation/candidates.jsonl in index order, the first 100 that incidents.build keeps on the job's platform (never trained on)

oracle.what: t1/rl/remediation/oracle.py: the exact inverse of the injected fault at the first operator step (it reads the fault from the incident, which no real operator can); the per-cell ceiling
oracle.reported: on every set, with the same measures as every operator; never part of pass/fail
oracle.flag: if the oracle's per-cell recovered rate on any set is below 0.90 the result carries a loud flag: the per-cell rule or the grade step is too strict for that share of incidents

secondary_measures.recovery: t3/evals/graders.py recovery at the grade step (mean over material KPIs)
secondary_measures.success: every graded KPI within tolerance of the same-step healthy counterfactual
secondary_measures.diagnosis_hit: the cell with the largest applied change (|d_power_db|/6 + |d_tilt_deg|/5) in the operator's first non-empty applied step is a faulted cell; no applied change at all is a miss
secondary_measures.cells_touched: distinct cells with a non-zero applied (safety-filtered) delta over the three operator steps
secondary_measures.total_abs_power_db: sum over operator steps and cells of |applied d_power_db|
secondary_measures.total_abs_tilt_deg: sum over operator steps and cells of |applied d_tilt_deg|
secondary_measures.headroom_used: energy proxy at the grade step: sum over cells of max(0, final power - commissioned power) divided by sum over cells of (power_max_dbm - commissioned power); 0 = no cell above its healthy power
secondary_measures.power_above_healthy_db: the numerator of headroom_used, in dB
secondary_measures.healthy_false_change: on the same network without the fault (commissioning only, state before the first operator step), the operator proposes a change
secondary_measures.reporting: per suite and operator: means and counts; paired-bootstrap intervals of v1 minus each baseline (same parameters as the primary) for every measure above. Only the primary (joint) is a target.
secondary_measures.percell_recovered: t3/evals/percell.py percell-v1: every cell green against its own healthy state at the grade step
secondary_measures.percell_degraded_cells: number of cells not green against their own healthy state at the grade step (percell-v1)
secondary_measures.percell_collateral_cells: number of non-faulted cells that end degraded AND worse than right before the first operator step (percell-v1)

executed_on: ml.m5.xlarge (the held-out set's freeze host; ml.m5.4xlarge failed the replay check on v1's first attempt); the fail-fast self-check replays 3 incidents per suite before any scoring
